[quote=states_of_arenenge;60194478]Hello guys. I'm making this post to inform you that I possibly might not be able to make a campaign. This is because I have multiple assignments and projects that I want to do in life. I will be normal in terms of activity in every other aspect, but I don't have the time to make a campaign. So instead of that, I will link my first and second campaign from my 1st and 2nd attempts at becoming president, along with some of my goals.

1st run for president:
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2646757

2nd run for president:
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2674972

[i]Those two links are my campaign factbooks. Please check them out to find out about some of the things I'm going to do. Keep in mind a lot of the stuff in there is outdated. But I will give you only a few ideas of what I will try to do if I become president.[/i]

[b]  Expand the cordoneballs discord game- Everyone who has discord loves Hydronia's ballsdex game, but I'm willing to expand it and make it more known to our users.

  Organize ministries- The ministries right now seem to be cluttered, and can't work together. I will try to organize them and harmonize the government of Cordone.

  Define roles- Currently, the government has some issues on who has more power than who, or who can do this but not that. I will fix this issue, even though it may seem small now, it will be an issue later on.

  Adding an assistant to some ministers- Currently, Thyven and his ministry are making big changed to Erene. I want to introduce assistants to the ministries in order to help them out.

  Making a court system- In our discord, there is a ticket system where a person calls for help in a situation, mostly for roleplay. This system is one sided, as when a person blames another, the defendent doesn't even know he is being blamed, and can't defend themselves. I aim to bring a fair, and honest trial, with a fair and honest outcome. Of course the ticket system will be there, but if you plan to seek help in a roleplay situation involving an aggressor nation, the court system will be of great help.[/b][/quote]
